name: shorefishing-condition
description: 연안 워킹 낚시 조건 적합도 스코어 — Capacitor Android 셸

scripts.prepare:android: npm run fonts && npx cap add android --confirm || true
scripts.sync: npm run fonts && npx cap sync android && npm run patch:android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
